title: Subsidy Scheme for KCC Cardholders:
summary: Schemes — Subsidy Scheme for KCC Cardholders:

items: o Objective: Provide short-term loans to farmers in agriculture and allied sectors (animal
o Loan Amount: Up to ₹3 lakh.
o Interest Rate: 7%, with a 3% rebate for timely repayment (effective rate of 4%).
o Repayment Period: Up to 3 years.
o Eligibility: Farmers holding a valid KCC (Kisan Credit Card).
o Impact: Reduces financial strain, supports productivity, and boosts farm income.
